mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy easing supports risk asset performance.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 9.0%, it signals severe labor market distress that triggers risk-off sentiment, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending capacity.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0, or t-test p-value > 0.05 for return difference vs baseline.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of rising unemployment (UNRATE > 8.5) and declining private employment (PAYEMS < 130000) signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger negative equity returns over 20 days due to income shock effects.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5 and PAYEMS < 130000.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%), higher discount rates reduce equity valuation multiples, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days as capital costs rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals expanding economic activity that increases corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate increases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production falls below 90.0, it signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0.

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 90.0) and falling housing starts (HOUST < 500) signals broad economic contraction that triggers negative equity returns over 20 days due to synchronized demand and supply shocks.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 90.0 and HOUST < 500.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 9.0), reduced household income and consumption demand suppresses corporate revenue growth, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 9.0.
